title: ooRexx Observation engineering sphere continuity records

records.rule: Engine snapshot generation is semantic state revision.
Observation stream sequence is retained observation ordering and replay key.
Queue package/correlation identity is delivery state, not observation identity.
Consumer checkpoint is last durably consumed stream sequence and is monotonic.
Observation subscriber lease is temporary read authority.
WLU delivery admission can delay Queue delivery but cannot remove/alter retained semantic history.
proofRef/capability generation are integration seams, not self-validating trust claims.
